title: Semantic Predicate Catalog Entry
description: A single reference-type predicate consumed by the advisory semantic-validation lane. Governs shared/semantic/reference-types/<rule_id>/predicate.yaml.

labeling_rubric.description: Optional human-labeler rubric — the SOUND/HOLLOW boundary encoded as anchor examples (one per class) that ship with the predicate under the FR-76 drift guard, so the C1 labeled set calibrates against the same boundary the judge is prompted on.
